name: OpenLP
shortDescription: Free, open-source worship-presentation software for displaying songs, Bible verses, media and service content on major desktop platforms.
suitableContexts: Teams using Windows, macOS or Linux and able to support their own setup

pricing.summary: OpenLP is free, open-source software under the GNU GPL. There is no subscription or paid trial; churches remain responsible for their own hardware, content and support arrangements.

tiers.label: OpenLP
tiers.detail: Open-source GNU GPL software; installs can be used without subscription fees

pricing.trialDetails: No time-limited trial is needed because the software is free to download and use.

editorial.assessment: OpenLP is an excellent cost-conscious presentation starting point where a church can own its own setup and support. Free software does not remove the need for rehearsal, backup plans, content licences or someone responsible for the presentation computer.
bestFor: Small churches seeking free presentation software
Technically confident volunteers who can test and maintain a local setup
strengths: Cross-platform presentation and browser-based remote control
limitations: Community rather than commercial support model
The church remains responsible for setup, resilience and content licensing

procurementVerdict.problem: Small churches seeking free presentation software
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Community rather than commercial support model

longForm.verdict: OpenLP is a strong fit where the budget needs to stay focused on hardware and content rather than subscriptions. The trade-off is that the church must be ready to own the setup, updates, rehearsals and contingency plan itself.

decisionLens.heading: Free software shifts the investment to preparation and support.
decisionLens.text: A successful live-service system needs a tested computer, display outputs, trained operators, media licences and a fallback plan. OpenLP removes subscription cost, not those operational responsibilities.

sections.heading: A practical free presentation stack
sections.question: Can the church make its local setup reliable enough for live use?
paragraphs: OpenLP publishes support for songs, Bible verses, presentations, images, audio, video and remote control across major desktop platforms. It is free and open source under the GNU GPL.
Run a full rehearsal with the actual projector, songs, Bible translations, videos and operator. Keep a simple backup such as exported slides or printed lyrics for the first live services.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an aggregate review score. It is based on the project’s own published feature, licensing and support information.
themes: No subscription cost makes a pilot accessible.
Local technical ownership and rehearsal discipline are central to fit.
userFeedback.caveat: Community testimonials are not treated as independent testing or a guarantee of compatibility with church hardware.

faq.question: Is OpenLP really free?
faq.answer: Yes. OpenLP is published as free, open-source software under the GNU GPL. There is no subscription fee, although the church still supplies hardware, content and support.

faq.question: Does OpenLP have a free trial?
faq.answer: A trial is not needed because OpenLP is free to download and use. Test it thoroughly with the church’s actual live-service equipment.

faq.question: Can OpenLP display songs and Bible verses?
faq.answer: Yes. The project describes song, Bible, media, custom-slide and presentation support, plus browser-based remote control. Check content licences separately.
